description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnectionController in a Swift iOS application. It tests various behaviors such as display name resolution, capability toggles, command availability, operator connect options, and persistence of last connection settings.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayNameSetsDefaultWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the default display name is set correctly when missing in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCapsReflectToggles
methods.description: Verifies that the current capabilities reflect the toggles set in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsIncludeLocationWhenEnabled
methods.description: Checks that location commands are included when enabled in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsExcludeDangerousSystemExecCommands
methods.description: Ensures dangerous system commands are excluded from current commands for safety.

methods.name: operatorConnectOptionsOnlyRequestApprovalScopeWhenEnabled
methods.description: Validates that only the necessary scopes are requested depending on the includeApprovalScope flag.

methods.name: operatorApprovalScopeRequestsStayBackwardCompatible
methods.description: Ensures backward compatibility for operator approval scope requests.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReadsSavedValues
methods.description: Tests reading of the last connection details saved in keychain storage.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReturnsNilForInvalidData
methods.description: Verifies that loading last connection returns nil for invalid stored data.
